episodes.title: Kimmy Goes Outside!
episodes.summary: Imprisoned by a cult leader as a teenager, Midwesterner Kimmy is freed after 15 years. The first thing she decides to do is move to New York.

episodes.title: Kimmy Gets a Job!
episodes.summary: Kimmy has to throw an acceptable kids' birthday party to keep her new job with the filthy rich Voorhees family.

episodes.title: Kimmy Goes on a Date!
episodes.summary: Kimmy and Jacqueline try to hide their pasts, while Titus lies to Lillian about money so he can spend it on headshots for his future.

episodes.title: Kimmy Goes to the Doctor!
episodes.summary: Kimmy has an eye-opening experience when Jacqueline introduces her to her plastic surgeon. Titus auditions for a Spider-Man musical.

episodes.title: Kimmy Kisses a Boy!
episodes.summary: Kimmy's bunker-mate Cyndee visits New York with her new boyfriend, Brandon, whom Titus promptly outs. Charles makes his move with Kimmy.

episodes.title: Kimmy Goes to School!
episodes.summary: Kimmy's GED class isn't as educational as she'd hoped. Lillian helps Titus shoot a music video ... in Jacqueline's house.

episodes.title: Kimmy Goes to a Party!
episodes.summary: Jacqueline asks Kimmy to help her plan a dinner party where Jacqueline can confirm if her husband, Julian, is cheating on her.

episodes.title: Kimmy Is Bad at Math!
episodes.summary: Kimmy studies for her math GED exam with her classmate Dong, while Jacqueline changes her mind about getting divorced.

episodes.title: Kimmy Has a Birthday!
episodes.summary: Kimmy's 30th birthday party isn't quite the fun celebration of adulthood she wants it to be.

episodes.title: Kimmy's in a Love Triangle!
episodes.summary: Kimmy is torn between two guys and trying not to act like a fool. Titus finds a different kind of acting coach.

episodes.title: Kimmy Rides a Bike!
episodes.summary: Titus can't stop watching the trial of Kimmy's charismatic kidnapper on the internet, while Kimmy turns to exercise to avoid testifying.

episodes.title: Kimmy Goes to Court!
episodes.summary: Kimmy and Titus go back to Durnsville, Indiana so Kimmy can testify against the Reverend Wayne, but the trip doesn't go very well.

episodes.title: Kimmy Makes Waffles!
episodes.summary: Kimmy is stuck in Durnsville. Jacqueline gets back in touch with her roots when she and Lillian drive to Indiana to find Kimmy.

episodes.title: Kimmy Goes Roller Skating!
episodes.summary: Titus's ex-wife sues him for spousal support. Kimmy stil has feelings for Dong. JAcqueline's Sioux family gets fed up with her.

episodes.title: Kimmy Goes on a Playdate!
episodes.summary: Kimmy helps Jacqueline put her life back together after the divorce. Titus donates his old clothes and makes a connection with a construction worker.

episodes.title: Kimmy Goes to a Play!
episodes.summary: Titus develops a one-man show about his past life as a Geisha. While Jacqueline tries to make Julian jealous, Lillian battles gentrification.

episodes.title: Kimmy Kidnaps Gretchen!
episodes.summary: Kimmy stages an intervention when ex-mole woman Gretchen joins another cult. Titus takes Mikey the construction worker on his first gay date.

episodes.title: Kimmy Gives Up!
episodes.summary: Kimmy needs to study for the GED, but she's worried about Dong getting deported. Jacqueline puts Buckley on Dyziplen to treat his hyperactivity.

episodes.title: Kimmy Drives a Car!
episodes.summary: Hipsters invade the neighborhood when Titus rents his apartment on Airbnb. Kimmy finally reaches her limit with Jacqueline's self-centered attitude.

episodes.title: Kimmy Walks Into a Bar!
episodes.summary: Jacqueline's Gala plans hit a snag when Deirdre Robespierre throws a party the same night. Kimmy stops to pee at a bar and meets a cute Army vet.

episodes.title: Kimmy Goes to a Hotel!
episodes.summary: On Fake Christmas, Kimmy and Dong take a trip to the poconos, and a Jewish family claims that Jacqueline's prized Mondrian is rightfully theirs.

episodes.title: Kimmy Meets a Drunk Lady!
episodes.summary: A drunk Uber passenger convinces Kimmy to stop repressing her emotions. Meanwhile, a broken R. Kelly cassette tape pushes Titus over the edge.

episodes.title: Kimmy Goes to Her Happy Place!
episodes.summary: Kimmy has her first therapy session with Andrea, but it's Lillian who helps her get in touch with her anger. Mikey comes out to his family.

episodes.title: Kimmy Meets a Celebrity!
episodes.summary: A celebrity psychologist with a TV talk show drives a wedge between Kimmy and her former bunker-mate Cyndee. Titus gives a teenage boy dating advice.

episodes.title: Kimmy Sees a Sunset!
episodes.summary: Kimmy tries to help Andrea with her drinking problem. Jacqueline dates a pro bono lawyer for his money. Titus and Mikey talk about moving in together.

episodes.title: Kimmy Finds Her Mom!
episodes.summary: While Kimmy reunites with her mom at Universal studios, Titus heads to Miami. Jacqueline invites Russ and his family to Thanksgiving dinner.

episodes.title: Kimmy Gets Divorced?!
episodes.summary: Back in New York, Titus goes to great lengths to score an audition for Sesame Street. Jacqueline encourages Kimmy to play hardball with the Reverend.

episodes.title: Kimmy's Roommate Lemonades!
episodes.summary: Titus unleashes his inner Beyoncé when he suspects Mikey of cheating, Kimmy checks out colleges, and Jacqueline and Lillian clash over city politics.

episodes.title: Kimmy Can't Help You!
episodes.summary: A surprise visitor delivers divorce papers to Kimmy. Jacqueline comes up with a plan to get Russ's dad to rename the Redskins.

episodes.title: Kimmy Goes to College!
episodes.summary: Kimmy makes a splash at Columbia University while doing odd jobs to save up for college. Titus sings backup for a controversial musician.

episodes.title: Kimmy Steps on a Crack!
episodes.summary: The FBI enlists Kimmy's help when former mole-woman Gretchen tries to start a cult of her own. Titus is stricken with a strange disease.

episodes.title: Kimmy Is a Feminist!
episodes.summary: Kimmy goes to her first college party with her new friends. Jacqueline calls Titus for backup when Russ's brother puts the moves on her.

episodes.title: Kimmy Learns About the Weather!
episodes.summary: Titus goes after Big Pharma when a drug company steals his likeness. Lillian convinces Kimmy that the weatherman can't be trusted.

episodes.title: Kimmy Does a Puzzle!
episodes.summary: Titus makes a shocking confession, and while a hurricane hits, Kimmy tries to make her bunker fun by adding fun games and puzzles.

episodes.title: Kimmy Goes to Church!
episodes.summary: Titus takes Kimmy to church for Good Friday and discovers a snake in their midst. Jacqueline gives Lillian a makeover for her new boyfriend's family.

episodes.title: Kimmy Pulls Off a Heist!
episodes.summary: Titus becomes outraged when he discovers his bodega now charges to use the restroom facilities and decides to steal the bathroom key with Kimmy. Jacqueline fights for the Redskins' name to be changed.

episodes.title: Kimmy Googles the Internet!
episodes.summary: Kimmy discovers the humiliating power of the Internet. Titus wonders if he's compatible with Reuben. Jacqueline takes care of Mimi after butt surgery.

episodes.title: Kimmy and the Trolley Problem!
episodes.summary: Russ's transformation opens doors for Jacqueline. Kimmy wrestles with a philosophical dilemma. Artie invites Lillian on a European cruise.

episodes.title: Kimmy Bites an Onion!
episodes.summary: Kimmy decides to become a crossing guard. Buoyed by the success of "Boobs in California," Titus tries to win back Mikey with help from Jacqueline.

episodes.title: Kimmy Is...Little Girl, Big City!
episodes.summary: Hoping to win Mikey back, Titus pretends he's starring in a TV show. As the new head of HR at Giztoob, Kimmy has to fire an employee.

episodes.title: Kimmy Has a Weekend!
episodes.summary: Kimmy and Titus spend the weekend binge watching TV and getting their nails done. Jacqueline schemes to evict her wealthy subletter.

episodes.title: Party Monster: Scratching the Surface
episodes.summary: In the probing documentary "Party Monster," DJ Fingerblast investigates what became of his childhood hero, DJ Slizzard.

episodes.title: Kimmy Disrupts the Paradigm!
episodes.summary: Kimmy tackles sexism at a tech conference while Lillian hits on men. Titus auditions for an acting troupe and researches nerds for a role.

episodes.title: Kimmy and the Beest!
episodes.summary: Titus directs a school musical but misses being in the spotlight. Jacqueline and Lillian try to scalp tickets to parents. Kimmy confronts a blogger.

episodes.title: Kimmy Meets an Old Friend!
episodes.summary: Titus struggles to come up with a pitch for "The Capist." Kimmy writes a children's book. Lillian meets Artie's kids. Jacqueline stands up for Xan.

episodes.title: Kimmy Fights a Fire Monster!
episodes.summary: A beefcake hits on Titus, Jacqueline enjoys attention from millennial men and Kimmy catches up with ex-mole woman Donna Maria.

episodes.title: Kimmy is in a Love Square!
episodes.summary: Kimmy finds herself in a compromising position. Titus has to make a difficult decision.

episodes.title: Sliding Van Doors
episodes.summary: What would Kimmy's life be if she never got into the Reverend's van and Titus missed his audition for "The Lion King".

episodes.title: Kimmy Finds a Liar!
episodes.summary: Kimmy discovers that Fran Dodd is posing as the author of her book; Jacqueline sets Titus up in a fake relationship with a celebrity.

episodes.title: Kimmy is Rich*!
episodes.summary: When Zach sells Giztoob for big bucks, Kimmy celebrates; Jacqueline hustles to keep Tripp as a client; Titus learns a secret about "Cats".

episodes.title: Kimmy Says Bye!
episodes.summary: Titus is torn between living his dream and winning Mikey back; Lillian takes a final stand against gentrification; Kimmy has an influential fan.
